sentences.en: Growing centrist sentiment threatens to upset America's traditional two-party system.
sentences.zh: 随着中间派情绪的增长，美国传统的两党制体系正面临被打破的风险。

sentences.en: Just study Buddhism. Don't follow the sentiments of the world.
sentences.zh: 只管学习佛教。不要随世人的感情而动。

sentences.en: I didn't even know that these sentiments still existed.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不知道这些观点和情感依然存在。

senses.zh: (对怜悯、怀旧等的)柔情 - 态度或意见 - 观点; 意见
